principles: Exactly one accountable owner per conclusion
Recommendations trace to evidence and decisions
Human approval required for AI-assisted drafts

maturity.name: Initial
maturity.definition: Practices are ad hoc, reactive, dependent on individuals and weakly evidenced.

maturity.name: Developing
maturity.definition: Foundational practices exist but coverage, ownership and consistency remain incomplete.

maturity.name: Managed
maturity.definition: Practices are defined, owned, measured and applied consistently across the agreed scope.

maturity.name: Optimised
maturity.definition: Practices are integrated, automated where appropriate and continuously improved using evidence.

maturity.name: Enterprise Leading
maturity.definition: Practices create measurable enterprise advantage and are governed as reusable organisational capability.

prompts.name: Generate Assessment Questions
prompts.instruction: Generate focused assessment questions mapped to scope, evidence, scoring and accountable owners.

prompts.name: Generate Executive Findings
prompts.instruction: Summarise verified strengths, gaps, risks, confidence and decisions for executives.

prompts.name: Generate Improvement Plan
prompts.instruction: Create sequenced improvement actions with owners, dependencies, evidence and measurable outcomes.

prompts.name: Generate Gap Analysis
prompts.instruction: Compare current evidence with the target maturity level and identify control and capability gaps.

prompts.name: Generate Roadmap
prompts.instruction: Sequence improvements into practical horizons without inventing dates, cost or capacity.

prompts.name: Generate Maturity Summary
prompts.instruction: Explain the evidence-supported maturity rating, uncertainty and conditions for advancement.

prompts.name: Generate Recommendations
prompts.instruction: Generate prioritised, evidence-linked recommendations with rationale, risk reduction and expected value.
